journey: Direct encrypted messages between Samsung and Xiaomi Android phones
evidenceOrigin: Human confirmations during the two-phone test; latency is user-reported, not instrumented

conditions.foreground: Both phones were instructed to remain unlocked with Lenz visible and Nearby enabled
conditions.connectivity: Wi-Fi and mobile data were instructed to remain off; this summary does not claim an independent radio-settings measurement

observations.result: Recipient confirmed the named test message exactly once
Reverse reply arrived; after the retry update the named retry check arrived
observations.latency: About 20 seconds according to the user

currentImplementation.scope: SHA256 fingerprints identify inspected working files, including later refactors. baselineCommit names the published parent, not these files' revision, the tested APK hash or an instrumented radio capture.

limitations: One direct two-phone foreground test. Direction-dependent delay remains visible; broad latency and reliability are not established.
Multi-hop, partitions, radio interruptions, process-restart radio recovery and background delivery were not physically verified by this test.
This message test does not establish Bluetooth payment delivery, blockchain settlement or an Android financial backend.
Lenz wire protocol does not interoperate with Bitchat clients. Radio presence, traffic timing, size and routing metadata remain observable; static message keys have no forward secrecy.
iOS is not implemented or tested.
